rationale: No supported optimization can be safely applied while preserving coverage. The workflow already caches Maven dependencies via `actions/setup-java` with `cache: 'maven'`, so adding a separate `actions/cache` for ~/.m2/repository (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE) is redundant and matches the contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists." The matrix explicitly sets `fail-fast: false` across three JDKs (11, 21, 25); switching to `fail-fast: true` (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) is contraindicated because every JDK outcome is independently required for compatibility coverage, the required-check status is unverified, and the supporting evidence is synthetic with an explicit required-check/branch-protection applicability review still needed. A custom job timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) lacks representative per-job successful-duration history and risks false timeouts on valid slow or cold runs. Therefore the existing build and test coverage is preserved unchanged.
